components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action used in heroes, forms, and examples.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { align-items:center; background:#171717; border:1px solid #171717; border-radius:8px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(24,21,31,.08); color:#fff; cursor:pointer; display:inline-flex; font:600 .875rem/1 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; min-height:44px; padding:0 16px; transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:#343431; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:scale(.975); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered action for alternatives and navigation.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { align-items:center; background:#fff; border:1px solid #e2e2de; border-radius:8px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(24,21,31,.08); color:#171717; cursor:pointer; display:inline-flex; font:600 .875rem/1 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; min-height:44px; padding:0 16px; transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background:#f0f0ed; border-color:#b8b8b1; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform:scale(.975); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The shared field treatment for text inputs and textareas.
components.css: .ds-input { background:#fff; border:1px solid #e2e2de; border-radius:8px; color:#171717; font:400 .875rem/1.4 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; min-height:44px; padding:8px 11px; transition:border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); width:100%; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#74746f; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#b8b8b1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:#0f766e; outline:2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact semantic label for state and catalog metadata.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { align-items:center; background:color-mix(in srgb,#1f7a4d 14%,#fff); border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,#1f7a4d 32%,transparent); border-radius:5px; color:#1f7a4d; display:inline-flex; font:650 .6875rem/1.45 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; padding:.15rem .4rem; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Documentation Card
components.description: A bordered container for imports, anatomy, and product details.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#fff; border:1px solid #e2e2de; border-radius:12px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(24,21,31,.08); color:#171717; font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; overflow:hidden; } .ds-card-header { border-bottom:1px solid #e2e2de; font-size:.875rem; padding:.85rem 1rem; } .ds-card-body { padding:1rem; } .ds-card-body code { font:500 .75rem/1.65 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; } .ds-card:hover { border-color:#b8b8b1; } .ds-card:focus-within { outline:2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: A dense documentation link with a quiet selected state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { border-radius:5px; color:#5f5f5b; display:block; font:400 .8125rem/1.4 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; padding:.35rem .5rem; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color:#171717; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current] { background:#f0f0ed; color:#171717; font-weight:580; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Example Frame
components.description: The preview and source unit used on styled component pages.
components.css: .ds-example { background:#fff; border:1px solid #e2e2de; border-radius:16px; color:#171717; overflow:hidden; } .ds-example-header { border-bottom:1px solid #e2e2de; font:620 .8125rem/1.4 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; padding:.75rem 1rem; } .ds-example-stage { align-items:center; background:#fafafa; display:flex; justify-content:center; min-height:180px; padding:32px; } .ds-example-button { background:#171717; border:1px solid #171717; border-radius:8px; color:#fff; font-weight:600; min-height:44px; padding:0 16px; } .ds-example-button:focus-visible,.ds-example-source:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-example-source { background:#fff; border:0; border-top:1px solid #e2e2de; color:#5f5f5b; cursor:pointer; font:500 .75rem/1.4 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; padding:.55rem .85rem; text-align:left; width:100%; } .ds-example-source:hover { color:#171717; }

narrative.overview:
Rigid UI reads like documentation built beside the code. Warm neutral surfaces, near-black accents, compact labels, and fine borders keep attention on examples and API facts. The system is quiet but not soft. Its dense navigation and precise type make it feel dependable.

The styled Components catalog and unstyled Primitives catalog share one shell but teach different things. Component pages use grouped recipes, generous previews, and source disclosure familiar to shadcn/ui users. Primitive pages favor Base UI-like import and anatomy references. Copy must stay honest about the planned registry: recipes live in the demo today and are not yet installable from a registry.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral canvases with near-black text and actions
Dense, persistent desktop navigation with a compact mobile catalog switcher
Large editorial page titles set against small technical labels and monospace code
Border-led structure, restrained elevation, and short state transitions
First-class light and dark themes with the same hierarchy in both

rules.name: The Ink Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Use the near-black accent for primary actions and decisive state. Do not spread it across decorative regions.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Dark mode changes token values, not information hierarchy. The same elements remain primary, muted, bordered, or raised.

rules.name: The Technical Accent Rule
rules.body: Monospace is a semantic cue for code and package identity. Do not use it as general decoration.

rules.name: The Two Catalogs Rule
rules.body: Components and Primitives remain visible as separate routes and navigation groups. Never collapse their content into an ambiguous single list.

rules.name: The Dense Edge, Open Page Rule
rules.body: Keep navigation compact. Give examples and reading content enough horizontal and vertical room to scan without crowding.

rules.name: The Floating Layers Rule
rules.body: Broad shadows indicate content that escaped document flow. Do not use them on ordinary page sections or preview frames.

rules.name: The Radius Follows Scale Rule
rules.body: Small object, small corner. Large container, larger corner. Avoid a single oversized radius across every element.

dos: **Do** keep Components and Primitives visually related but structurally separate.
**Do** use borders and tonal changes before reaching for shadows.
**Do** reserve monospace for imports, source, paths, versions, and anatomy names.
**Do** preserve focus outlines, coarse-pointer target sizes, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** say that the registry is planned and point readers to the demo source that exists today.
donts: **Don't** present the styled recipes as installable registry packages before that registry ships.
**Don't** turn semantic teal, green, amber, or rose into broad decorative color.
**Don't** hide the catalog split inside one undifferentiated navigation tree.
**Don't** add large shadows to normal documentation sections.
**Don't** replace the dense desktop sidebar with oversized marketing navigation.
